# Third-party assets

- Bootstrap 2.3.1: the site's existing CSS and JavaScript, retained without a
  framework upgrade. The missing glyphicons sprite files were restored from
  <https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v2.3.2/img>. Original license notices
  remain in the source files.
- jQuery 1.9.1: the site's existing minified distribution, including its license
  notice.

Unused Blueimp and social-button assets are under `archive/legacy/`.
